lines.en: : Actually, Sir...On second thought, I don’t think this is a good idea anymore.
: It sounded reasonable when we were in my room, but now that I’m in front of her door, I’m beginning to think that this isn’t exactly “staying away.”
: Isn’t that the entire reason we came down here? Because staying away isn’t helping either of you?
: I don’t know...If what Haruka says is true, Rin has been doing pretty okay without me.
: And it’s not like I’m doing anything self-destructive either. I’m just more...tired. Both physically and mentally.
: Molly, what happens in a game if you give up or fail a quest?
: You normally just get to try again later.
: See? You’ll never-
: Wait, really? That’s not a harsh consequence at all.
: I know! Which is one of the many reasons I keep telling you that games are better than real life!
: If I fail this mission now, I might not be able to try again!
: But, on the other hand, if you succeed...you get your best friend and unrequited love back.
: Rejoice! Another chance to be unloved!
: Just kidding. The first part sounds rather nice.
: I just don’t think it’s going to go the way you imagine, Sir.
: For all we know, Rin could be in there unlocking event CGs with her new girlfriend right now.
: Or, alternatively, she could be in there sleeping.
: How is that any better?
: Would you rather her be fingering Otoha?
: I’d rather her be fingering me.
: There’s the Molly I know and...don’t love.
: Thank you, Sir. Thank you for not loving me.
: Don’t take it personally. I don’t really love anyone.
: This disclaimer should have been printed on the back of the cartridge before I plugged it into my system.
: There’s no way they’re still using cartridges for games in this day and age.
: They’re not, Sir. I intentionally dated my analogy so you wouldn’t get confused by it.
: Appreciated. Now, are we doing this or not?
: Molly?
: Um...Rin?
: I’m sorry to bother you even though you told me to stay away...but I was wondering if...I could come in for a minute or two.
A moment of silence goes by as Molly and I wait out in the hall.
The rest of the girls are holed up inside of their rooms right now and are likely trying to go to sleep given the fact it’s-
: Holy shit. Is it really midnight already?
: Today went by way too quickly.
: I don’t think she’s in there, Sir. And...if she is, she’s probably sleeping.
: Why not go in and check? That’s what I always do when I’m in doubt.
: Why aren’t you understanding that me being intrusive is exactly what got me into this mess? I’m not going to fix that by...being intrusive in a slightly different way.
: You don’t know that, though.
: I do know that, though.
: Well, if you want to give up now, we can always-
: Excellent idea, Sir. Let’s give up now and try again later.
: Hah...
: Well, it’s an anticlimactic end to the night. But if that’s really what you think is-
: Wait.
: Listen.
: I think I heard something.
: Heard what? It’s the middle of the night.
: ...Which is also the perfect time to unlock event CGs.
: No way. She’s probably just talking in her sleep.
: I’m scared, Sir.
: If you’re that scared, just leave. That’s what we were about to do anyway.
: Yes, but...that was before we confirmed movement.
: The event is already in progress. We can’t back out anymore.
: Is that really how it works?
: I’m going in.
: How did we switch sides on this matter so quickly?
: Rin?
: I’m coming-
: AHH!
: What are you doing?!
: Heeeeeeeeeeey.
: What’s up, you guys?
: Rin, what have you done?! I thought you stopped!
: You told me you stopped!
: Heheh...
: Whoooooops...
: Looks like I’m a liar...
: Rin...
: Careful, Molly. Your hands are gonna get all messy.
: I...I don’t...
: When did you do this?
: Aaaaaay, Sensei’s here too.
: Rin-
: Just look. When do you think I did it, dude? Why’s that even matter?
: That’s...so much blood...
: Why?
: Felt like it.
: Are you okay? Well, I mean...obviously you’re not okay. But...are you feeling lightheaded? Are you dizzy?
: Molly.
: Molly, Molly, Molly.
: Molly, Molly, Molly, Molly, Molly.
: What? What is it?
: You fucked up, girl.
: What?...
: This...isn’t because-
: Oh, no. No no no. This isn’t your fault. It’s nobody’s.
: Just happens sometimes.
: Sorry. Hard to think when my body feels like it’s being packed into a ziplock bag.
: Then...how did I mess up?
: Cause you chose me, idiot.
: Is this really what you want?
: Okay, you didn't have to say it like-
: What is that supposed to mean?
: Just that you can do better. That’s all.
: Did something happen to cause this?
: You know, that’s the craziest part.
: Everything’s fine. I’ve got no reason to be like this anymore.
: But I am!
: I am like this!
: It never ends, Sensei.
: The pain isn’t even pain anymore.
: It’s just...numb.
: I had everything.
: I have everything.
: Why can’t I just enjoy it?
: You realize doing this is just going to hurt everyone else, don’t you?
: Mhm.
: And, for the record, I didn’t just decide to like you one day. There was no choice involved.
: So...So don’t tell me I messed up when I didn’t ask for any of this!
: I’ve liked you for so long! Those feelings aren’t a mistake!
: I know.
: But you can do better.
: Why can’t you just let me make you feel better?
: Even now, when you need someone more than anything?
: It’s not that simple, Molly.
: I know that!
: But even if she’s like this right now, it hurts to hear all of the pain I’ve felt called some sort of...mistake!
: I just wanted to know if she was okay! I’m worried!
: I’m...really worried...
: Sorry, yo...
: I don’t know what I’m doing anymore...
: Molly...can you run to the bathroom or...downstairs to see if you can find something to wrap her arm up with?
: I’ll look after Rin while you’re gone.
: I’m...so glad we didn’t just go back to my room...
: I don't know what I would have done if...
: I’m just...so glad...
: Futaba?
: Sensei? You’re calling really late. Is something wrong?
: Where are you right now?
: I’m at a diner with Nodoka. I know it’s late, but if you want to join us-
: There’s a problem with Rin.
: Can you come back to the dorm?
: A problem with-
: Yes. I’ll leave right now.
: Please stay with her until I’m back.
: Planned on it. Thanks.
: Futaba’s on the way.
: I heard. You keep your volume up so loud, man.
: Yes. Let’s talk more about the volume of my phone instead of the blood dripping down your arm.
: You know...it’s so weird.
: I actually had a really good day today.
: Otoha came and visited me at work...and then we made plans to go to the movies this weekend.
: She was even all cute and kissed me on the cheek before she left.
: I mean, yeah...she looked both ways like five times to make sure nobody was watching first, but that didn’t really bother me.
: But then...this wound up happening.
: Why?
: You don’t actually think I have an answer for that, do you?
: Guh. I got myself pretty good this time, didn’t I?
: Should we call an ambulance or something? I don't really know what's bad or...less bad when it comes to this.
: Mmmmmm...probably not.
: I didn’t mean to go that deep. It was just a new boxcutter and-
: I don’t care what it was. You shouldn’t have done this.
: Easier said than...not done, I guess.
: You think I like this, Sensei?
: I didn’t say that...
: It was only a matter of time, you know.
: These sorts of things come in waves.
: They pull you under and start drowning you before you even have the chance to buckle up your lifejacket.
: Except you’ve openly admitted to not wanting to wear a “lifejacket” in the past because of how it makes you feel.
: Heheh. Lifejacket means pills. I get it.
: It's not funny.
: Relax, Sensei...I haven’t drowned yet.
: “Yet” being the key word.
: I’ve told you, haven’t I?
: I don’t want to die...I don’t want to feel like this at all...
: And yet, once or twice a week, I’ll feel this...blanket of everything I’m afraid of draped over me.
: It’s so heavy, Sensei. I can’t breathe when it’s on top of me.
: I can’t think or feel or...anything.
: I just can’t.
: In every sense of the word...I can’t.
: There’s no other way I know how to describe it.
: I really don’t know what you want me to say here.
: That’s fine.
: It’s not like there’s anything I could hear that would just magically make me feel better anyway.
: Some people just aren’t allowed to be happy I guess.
: Ngh! That stings.
: Try not to grip so hard, please.
: I have to keep putting pressure on your wrist until Molly gets back with something to wrap you up with.
: You're gonna have to grab more than just that one spot, then. They're all over the place.
: This is where the important veins are. I think.
: Why did you bring Molly here anyway?...
: Does that really matter right now?
: We could probably talk about it some other time, but you squeezing me just now just made me aware of how much I’m bleeding and...I’m starting to get nauseous.
: Well, you should have thought of that before you went and did something this stupid.
: It’s not stupid...
: It’s just a little...self-destructive.
: Sounds pretty stupid to me.
: It’s easy to look at what someone else does to try and feel better and write it off as dumb...but to me, this makes sense.
: It’s something I can control. Something I have power over when the rest of me is stripped away.
: I can’t say I’m a big fan of you justifying why it’s acceptable for you to bleed all over my hands as it’s happening.
: True. And it must really suck since I didn’t even flash you to take your mind off of it all tonight.
: That wasn’t something I enjoyed, for the record. It was incredibly depressing.
: Yeah, well...if you’re gonna keep hanging around me while I’m like this, chances are you might get a little depressed every now and then.
: You’ve always got the option to walk away, you know.
: Molly, too.
: If I were her, I probably would have ran off the moment I said she fucked up.
: Molly’s actually been surprisingly mature about this whole situation. I’ve been with her all night.
: Bet that makes me look like a real immature son of a bitch then, huh?
: I’m going to do my best to abstain from judging you right now, thanks.
: You’re cute when you pretend to care.
: Don’t let Otoha hear that or there might be another breakdown like this in store for the near future.
: Fuck!
: Fuck fuck fuck!
: What am I gonna tell Otoha?
: Doesn’t she already know you have a history of...this?
: Yes, but if she finds out that I started doing it again right after we started dating, how do you think that’s going to make her feel?!
: I imagine pretty shitty.
: No. No no no no no no no no no. I have to hide it. She can’t know.
: If she knows then she’ll start worrying. If she worries too much, she’ll get exhausted. If she’s exhausted, she won’t want me anymore.
: I have to be wanted. I need her to want me. I can’t lose her now, Sensei. I can’t. I can’t. I can’t. I can’t.
: Calm down.
: You’re good at hiding this sort of thing, aren’t you?
: That’s right. Yeah. I’m good at hiding this. She’s not going to find out.
: I mean, it would probably be best if you just dropped this habit altogether as well but, based on what you said earlier, I can’t foresee that happening any time soon.
: I’ll stop. I’ll stop for Otoha. Otoha doesn’t want me to do this. I’ll get better. I’ll be better.
: I won’t cut myself anymore. I’ll be happier. I’ll be the happiest girl in the world.
: I have everything I want. Why on earth would I be sad?
: Fuck!
: Why can’t I fucking feel anything?!
: I’m supposed to be better now!
: I’m...supposed to..
: Be better now...
: Sensei...
: Why can’t I feel anything?...
Molly shows up a few minutes later with some gauze she bought from a nearby convenience store.
Apparently, she couldn’t find any in the bathroom or her room, so she frantically took off down the road without checking the lobby for any medical supplies.
Either way, by the time she gets back, the bleeding has mostly stopped.
I wrap up Rin’s arm the best I can but it is admittedly not great.
Once Futaba gets back, though, she redoes it herself.
It looks like she’s had practice.
What a terrible thing to become experienced at.
Rin’s affection has increased to [rin_love]!
At least she can feel that.
